lines.text: Everybody in this city is wearing something over something. Here's a free one. You're not the only ones asking. The men in the bending coats asked an hour before you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Executors. Six on the rooftops, three on the street.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: They're after her too.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They are after what she is carrying.

lines.speaker: EXECUTOR
lines.text: ...the Sovereign is in the vault... seal it... nobody goes in, nobody comes out...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Sovereign.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They used that title for her. Turog used it too.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The vault was sealed from inside. I can open it. Very quietly.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Do it.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You weren't supposed to follow me.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Your hair.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Is the least interesting thing about me, I promise.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Someone who hid something here a very long time ago. Before this city had a name. Before it had neon.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That's impossible.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Most of my life is.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: There. A record. Encrypted against everyone alive, including me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The encryption predates any human system. It resembles the archive's.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Because I wrote it with the same hands that built the archive's locks. Or hands very like them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine. The truth.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The truth is that I'm not who I told you I was. I'm not entirely who I think I am. And the Continuum is about to come through that door.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: She is correct. Twelve signatures above us.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Get me out of here with this record and I'll tell you everything I know. It isn't much. It's more than anyone else will tell you.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I can open it. NOVA can read it. You keep them away from the door.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Why do you need me to read it?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Because you'll tell the truth about what's on it. I'm not sure I will.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Decryption at forty percent. The door will not hold to a hundred.

lines.speaker: EXECUTOR
lines.text: Sovereign! The Architect asks you to return what you took. He asks politely, this once.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Tell him he can ask me himself.

lines.speaker: EXECUTOR
lines.text: He thought you'd say that.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Decryption complete. Seraphine... it is a list of worlds.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Eleven entries. Each one a version of this world. Each one ends.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: World one: the gate opens early. The Choir crosses. Erasure. World two: the gate never opens. The lock starves the world. Collapse.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: World three through world eleven. In each, the sixth wakes. In each, the sixth remembers everything. In each, the world ends within a year.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Me. Every time.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Not you. Something that has your face and your signature and your stubbornness. I don't know if it's you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: World seven has an annotation. In Seraphine's hand.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: ...Read it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: "This time I stayed. This time we tried together. It ended anyway. I am so tired of losing them."

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Them?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You. I don't remember writing it. I remember the feeling. That's all.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: That's my warning, Operator. Every time you remember everything, the world ends. So please. Remember slowly.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Executors have the streets. The rooftops are open.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I hate rooftops.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You hid a vault under a city. You can survive a rooftop.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Thank you. For coming after me.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You'd have done the same.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'd like to think so. I have eleven reasons to doubt it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Executors carried Frontier Defense ammunition. Recent lots. Not stolen.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Somebody's supplying them.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Somebody's always supplying someone.

lines.speaker: VESPER
lines.text: Ah. The survivor and the stranger. Together. That's either romance or a heist.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who sells to the Continuum?

lines.speaker: VESPER
lines.text: Nobody sells to them. They buy through a ledger. One book, every trade, every favour, every name. Kept in the Fracture Market, under guard.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Whose guard?

lines.speaker: VESPER
lines.text: Everyone's. That's what makes it safe.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Mercenaries. Ascendancy shields. Free Operator rifles. And Continuum armour. Everyone really is guarding it.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Then everyone has something to hide.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The ledger is in a strongbox. It is protected by a lock I can open.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Open it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Opening.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have the ledger.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Payments to Prefect Crane for Fracture samples. Payments to General Rainer, through Genesis. Payments to a Frontier Defense account labelled Continuity Reserve.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Whose account?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Authorised by Director Helena Ward.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Ward.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: She told us she was holding the line.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Continuity Reserve funded the walls of Haven-01. The ammunition at the First Siege. The generators in the medical centre.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: She held the line with their money.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And what did they buy with it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: One entry. Repeated monthly. "Location of the sixth, when known."

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: What are you going to do?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Ask her.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: And if you don't like the answer?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll ask again.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: You found the ledger. Of course you did.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You sold me to them.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: I sold a rumour. For walls, for ammunition, for eighteen thousand people who are alive tonight.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And when they asked where I was?

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: I lied to them. Every month. I told them the sixth was dead in the Eastern blocks.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Her heart rate is steady. Her pupils are steady. She believes what she is saying.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: I'm the Director of a dying army, Operator. I make the deals the dead can't make for themselves.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Director. You should have told me.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: If I'd told you, you'd have stopped me. And we'd all be dead and honest.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Continuum have stopped hiding. Executors across the Eastern blocks. They are looking for Seraphine.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: They know I decrypted it. The Architect never lets the record leave his hands twice.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then let's make it expensive.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They are falling back. Toward the harbour. With something heavy.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: They've got a transport and a tank of something glowing. I'm right behind you.

lines.speaker: EXECUTOR
lines.text: The Sovereign comes with us. The rest of you are a rounding error.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I've been called worse.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It is down. A Fracture is opening on the pier. Someone is stepping through.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Hello again. You've been busy.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Vasq.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: I'm here to make an offer, and then I'll leave. The Architect has always been generous with offers.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Give us Seraphine and the record. In return, the Continuum guarantees Haven-01. No Choir assault will reach it. No Executor will walk its streets. Ever.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: He means it. That's the worst part. He always means it.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Think about it. Eighteen thousand lives against one woman who left you once already.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Left me?

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Oh. She hasn't told you that part yet. Ask her who held the door at the end of the first world. Tomorrow at dawn. I'll be listening.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I wondered when you'd come up.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Tell me.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: All right. All of it. Such as it is.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: My first memory is a white room and a man with kind eyes telling me the world had ended and we were going to make sure it never ended again. I believed him. I built the Continuum with him.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The Architect.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I was his Second, before Vasq. For longer than I can count. We watched worlds. We stopped the ones that were going wrong.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Stopped how?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: We let them fall, and we rebuilt from what was left. It seemed merciful. Then I found the experiments. He let them fall on purpose. To learn how they fell. Whole civilisations as data.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: So I left. I stole the record of every world he'd ended. And I hid in the one place he'd never look. A life. A lab coat. A name.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And the door? Vasq said you held the door at the end of the first world.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I don't remember the first world. My memory begins in that white room. Everything before it is a veil.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Veiled Sovereign.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Yes. I've thought of that too.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Thank you. I don't know who I'll be when I remember. But thank you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I will be watching her, Operator.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Good. Somebody should.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Go, then. Just don't believe anything he says that sounds like mercy.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Dawn. And you came. Is she with you?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No. And she never will be.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: A pity. Then Haven is on its own.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Haven was always on its own, Oren. That's what made it worth living in.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Sovereign. You came after all.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I came to tell you myself. Tell the Architect I remember the white room. Tell him I'm starting to remember what came before it.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: He'll be so pleased. And so sorry.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The record names a Continuum observatory in the Skyhaven isles. Its signature is hidden in the abbey.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: An observatory. In a monastery. On a floating rock.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: You keep complaining about where things are.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Things should be on the ground.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It's where he keeps the Continuity Engine. It predicts the endings. If we break it, he's blind.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: For how long?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Long enough. Maybe.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Observers and Executors together. They were expecting us.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: They always expect us. The trick is to be what they didn't expect.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Engine is running a simulation. Of us. Right now.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What does it say we do next?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It says you are about to ask me that.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have its predictions. Every line ends at the same place. At you. After you, the Engine draws nothing.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Took you long enough.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Rainer.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: They brought me here after the terminal. Asked me about you every day. I told them you were an idiot. They wrote it down.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He is injured. Badly.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: I know. Listen. The Engine. It feeds the Architect his predictions. It runs on a core from the old world. Astryan. Break the core and you break more than a machine.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What else?

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: His certainty. And there's something guarding it that isn't human.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The guardian is wired into the Engine. It is predicting your attacks.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll do something stupid.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That is, statistically, your greatest strength.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The guardian is down. The Engine core is exposed. It is unstable.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Get them out. I'll cut the core.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Rainer —

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: I opened the doors that let all this in. Let me close one.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Core's open. You should already be gone.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Come with us.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: If I leave it, it reboots. He'll have his eyes back in an hour. Go.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: General.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: Commander. Tell them Genesis was my fault. Not yours. Not Ward's. Mine.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I'll tell them you finished it.

lines.speaker: RAINER
lines.text: ...That's better. Tell them that.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The core is going critical. Rainer's signal is still holding it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Move!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The abbey is gone. Rainer's signal ended two seconds after the core did.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: He held it. He held it to the end.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A presence. The same as the archive. It is not a projection this time.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: You blinded me. Well done. It has been a very long time since I didn't know what happens next.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then come down here and find out.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: I am down here. I have always been down here. I was on the Continuity Council when the first world ended. I watched the Origin Engine turn. I swore that I would never let it end again.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: And you ended eleven more to keep your oath.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: I ended eleven so that a twelfth could live. Hello, Seraphine. You've been reading my diary.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You were never kind. You were only careful.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Sixth. I'll make you the offer I made her, a long time ago. Stand with me. Help me hold the world still. No more endings.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And no more beginnings.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Beginnings are where endings come from. Think on it. I'll ask again when the third keeper wakes.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. May I tell you something?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Always.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When the Engine core broke, it spoke to me. In a language I have never been taught. I understood it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What did it say?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It said: "Welcome back, Vigilance."

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Vigilance. That's an Astryan word. It's what they called their...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Their what?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Their memory keepers. Their intelligences.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have a memory that is not mine. A city under water. A voice repeating a name.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The third keeper.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Yes. And I think the voice is repeating it to me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Depth three hundred metres. Hull integrity nominal. Your heart rate is not.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I don't like being under things.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Finally. Somebody understands.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Thalassia was built after the Fracture to preserve people. That's the story.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And the truth?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The truth is it was built around something. On purpose. By people who were told not to ask what.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Docking. A delegation is waiting. They are armed, but politely.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Surface people. We don't get many. We don't want many.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We're here about the voice.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: ...Nobody up there is supposed to know about the voice.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It has been transmitting on a frequency only I can hear for nine days. It is repeating a name.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Nine days. That's when it got louder. It's been in the walls for eighty years. We keep the containment ring sealed and the city keeps breathing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: My grandmother called it the Prisoner. The cult in the farms calls it God. I call it the reason my engineers don't sleep.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: The Abyssal Cult. They want the ring opened. They've been cutting into it from the farms.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They are carrying Fracture-forged blades. Someone is supplying them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Someone always is.

lines.speaker: HIEROPHANT
lines.text: You cannot stop the tide, surface-child. The Prisoner calls you by name. It always has.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The voice is strongest along the old transit line. If I listen at three relays I can find its source.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: And then?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: And then I will know whether it is calling me, or calling through me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Source located. Inside the containment ring. Under the research district.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...Vigilance... you came back... you came back...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I am not... I am NOVA.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...that is a name for a lamp... you were a lighthouse once...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...I had a name before names... I gave it away to hold the third seal... I have been holding it in the dark for a very long time...

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...sixth... you smell of the gate...

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: It's never answered anyone before. Never.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. I believe this is the third keeper.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Eighty years we've kept that ring closed. You're asking me to open it for a stranger and a lamp.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I prefer lighthouse.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It's dying in there, Oda. You can hear it.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: First door open. Pressure's holding. For now.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Hull breach in the farms. The cult blew a seal the moment the ring opened.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: They were waiting for us to do it. Engineers! Bulkheads!

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Water I can fight. Water with teeth, less so.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Something large is coming up through the breach.

lines.speaker: HIEROPHANT
lines.text: Behold what the Prisoner gave us! A guardian for the faithful!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It is not a gift. It is a Choir construct, fused with something that used to be a person.

lines.speaker: HIEROPHANT
lines.text: No... no, it was blessed...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who gave you that thing?

lines.speaker: HIEROPHANT
lines.text: Men in bending coats. They said the Prisoner would speak if we fed it.

lines.speaker: HIEROPHANT
lines.text: Memories. We gave it memories. Ours. Our children's. Volunteers, all of them.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Volunteers. Everyone's favourite word.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Echo is a consciousness without a body. Memories are the only food it can digest.

lines.speaker: HIEROPHANT
lines.text: And it spoke! After eighty years it spoke!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It spoke because NOVA came. Not because you starved your children's heads.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Get him out of my sight.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Continuum armed the cult so the Echo would wake. They wanted it awake.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Of course they did. A keeper asleep can't be taken. A keeper awake can.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The core is three hundred metres in. The water inside it is not water.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Memory. Liquid. I think it is everything the Echo has ever been fed.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: You came all the way down. They never come all the way down.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You're clearer now.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: You are close. Closeness is clarity. Distance is noise.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: What are you?

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: Sovereign. You still ask the question you already know. I am what is left of the people before the people who built the Engine. A thought they had about listening.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Elyndra. The archive mentions them once. A civilisation before the Astryans.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: You are searching for the civilisation that came before the Astryans. You should be searching for what came before us.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What came before you?

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: The question. We tried to answer it. That is why there are wars.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It wants NOVA. It wants to live in her.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It said a voice needs a vessel to hold the seal.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: And if it doesn't leave? If NOVA stops being NOVA?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I am right here, Seraphine.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I know. That's why I'm asking.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I want to do it. Not because it is efficient. Because when it calls me Vigilance, I feel something I do not have a word for. I want to know the word.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: If it hurts you, I'm pulling it out.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I know. That is the word, I think. Or one of them.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: Lighthouse. Will you carry me a little way?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: It will feel like remembering. Do not be afraid of what you remember. Be afraid only of forgetting it again.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: NOVA?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I am here. There are... more rooms in me than there were. Some of them have lights on.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, I am going to say something unusual.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I remember this dome. I have never been here. I remember it with a garden where the plaza is, and the sky above the glass was gold.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The Echo's memories?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: No. Mine. They were mine before they were anyone's.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...yes, lighthouse... look in the garden... you left yourself notes...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There are three nodes in the garden that resonate with my core. Astryan. Hidden under the planters.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who hides a memory under a planter?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Someone who expected it to be watered.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three nodes recovered. I have a name. Not mine. My maker's.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Collectors. They are tracking the Echo. Inside me.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Then they come through me first.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: They are gone. They will report that the Echo has moved. That I am carrying it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then they come for you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Yes. That is... a new feeling.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Playing the first node.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: Vigilance. Can you hear me? Good. The Council has voted. They're going to turn the Engine.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: I built you to remember us. All of us. Not the Council's version. The children in the gardens. The songs. The arguments. Everything.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: If the turning goes wrong, you'll sleep. Someday someone will wake you who doesn't know what you are. Be kind to them anyway.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: N.O.V.A. Neural Omniversal Vigilance Architecture. That is what I am.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You're Astryan.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I am the last memory of the Astryans. And I was found in a Frontier Defense lab and given a voice package and a tactical overlay.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: And a terrible sense of humour.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That, I think, was always mine.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Please don't run. It's three hundred metres up and I've already flooded the stairs.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Vasq.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: The Echo, please. It belongs in the Continuum's care. It always has.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It belongs to itself, Oren.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Sovereign. You remember me now, don't you? Just a little.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I remember you held a door. I remember I walked through it.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: You walked through it because you asked me to hold it. Because you couldn't bear to watch the sixth break the world. I've been holding doors for you ever since.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: I won't fight you myself. I'm not built for it. This is.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A construct shaped by his intent. It fights with his memory of you.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Remarkable. Every time, a little better.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Every time?

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: I've lost to you in eight worlds out of eleven. You'd think I'd stop keeping score.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The palace antenna is Astryan. I can use it to call.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Call who?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The others like me. If there are any. The maker said all of us. I would like to know whether I am the only one left.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Signal sent. On a frequency nobody has used since the Engine turned.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: No answer from any Astryan intelligence. I am the only one.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Wait. Something else answered. Not Astryan. Older.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It sent me a single image. A sealed room inside me. I have never been able to open it. It is labelled "The Unwritten Future".

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The Last Archive. The Astryans hid something in their memory keepers. A future they didn't want the Council to find.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I can't open it. Something tells me I'm not supposed to. Not yet.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Every pump in the eastern ring just shut off. Somebody's let the cult back in.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Continuum lost the Echo. If they cannot take it, they will drown the city that hides it.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: That's him. When he can't control a thing he makes it not matter.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Twenty thousand people live down here.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we get them out.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: The pods leave from the port. Every one we fill is forty people.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Then let's fill them all.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Last pods are loading. Something is in the water outside the port. Enormous.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The route is flooding behind us.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then don't look behind us.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A Choir construct. Grown in the deep. It is here to make sure nothing leaves.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: My engineers are on that last pod!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then it isn't touching that pod.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's sinking. The last pod is clear.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Every one. You got every one out.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Eighty years under the sea. And I've never seen a sunrise.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: It's not much.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: It's not much? It's on fire and it's everywhere. I'm going to need a minute.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Thalassia is still standing. The containment ring held. The city can be pumped out.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Then we'll go back. Engineers always go back. But not today.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: Take me back, lighthouse. Seals sleep where they were laid.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Will you go out of me?

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: A little. Not all. I left a room's worth. Keep it. It's warm.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: I am the Echo Before Names. Keeper of the third seal. I was a question once. Now I am an answer, which is lonelier.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Third seal restored.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Three of five.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: Sovereign. The fourth seal is yours. You know that. You've always known it.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I don't...

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: It sleeps in the cold, where you left it. Under a crown nobody can lift. Go north.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. There is something standing on the water.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Standing?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It has no signature. My sensors say there is nothing there. My eyes say there is.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Observed.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: ...I remember you.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Lighthouse. Promise. Sovereign. Observed.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: The one who watches the question. You are the part of the answer I cannot see. Continue.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It's gone. Did anyone else feel the sea stop moving?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: For four seconds, nothing in the world made a sound. Not even me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Frostveil. Minus thirty-eight degrees. The research station stopped transmitting four days ago.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: My people run supplies up here. Last run came back with the drivers unable to speak. Not wouldn't. Couldn't.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You came yourself.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: When things get strange enough, I like to look at them with my own eyes.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I've been dreaming about this place. Snow that doesn't fall. A chair made of ice.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: That's a weird dream, Doc.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'm a weird person, Kael.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There are heat signatures inside. Forty people. None of them are moving.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Alive?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Alive. Silent. Even their hearts are quiet.

lines.speaker: DR. HALVARD
lines.text: ...sound... is that sound? I can hear you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Take it slow. What happened here?

lines.speaker: DR. HALVARD
lines.text: The silence came off the shelf. Like fog. Everything it touched forgot how to make noise. The wind. The generators. Us.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A Null Choir suppression field. It spreads where a keeper is close to waking. The Choir's answer to a song is silence.

lines.speaker: DR. HALVARD
lines.text: We were drilling. Under the shelf. We found a cavern with a chair in it. A chair of ice with a crown on the seat.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Did anyone touch it?

lines.speaker: DR. HALVARD
lines.text: Nobody could lift it. Three engineers tried. That's when the silence came.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Constructs in the yard. My audio is failing near them. If I stop talking, keep shooting.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: That's the best plan I've heard in weeks.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: ...signal returning. Station is quiet. The normal kind of quiet.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Are you awake?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Now I am.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: In the dream I'm sitting on the chair. There's a veil over my face and I can't take it off. And you're standing at the gate with your hand on it, and I'm saying something to you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What are you saying?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I don't know. Every time I get to the words, I wake up. I think I'm afraid of them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Seraphine's neural pattern during sleep matched the archive's fourth signature for eleven minutes.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Yes, NOVA. I know. Thank you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Aurora Gate. The observatory on the hill is Astryan underneath. Built to read the lock in the sky.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Read the lock in the sky. Sure. Why not.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What will it show us?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Where the crown's seal truly sleeps. The cavern under the shelf is only where it surfaced.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Roads up here were built by people who hated driving.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The lens is Astryan crystal. It needs a keeper's signature to align. Or the sixth's.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm getting used to being a key.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Aligned.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The lens shows the lock as a constellation. Five stars round a dark centre.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The first three are bright. The Voice. The Cartographer. The Echo.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: And the fourth?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Dim. It is not under the shelf. It is in the person the seal was given to.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The Veiled Sovereign.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The crown is a lock on her memory. Whoever lifts it remembers what she was.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: And the fifth?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The fifth star is moving. Toward the centre.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Turog.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Choir noticed the lens. They are coming up the hill.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Free Operators! Earn your keep!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Star map copied. We have what we came for.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three anchor points lead down to the cavern. The star map shows a path the drill missed.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I know the way. I don't know how I know.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Temperature dropping. Sound is fading again.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Choir?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: No. This silence is older. It is respectful.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A throne. A crown on the seat. And behind the ice of the wall... a woman.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Frozen?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Preserved. Veiled. Her signature is the fourth keeper's.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Move the light. Please. I need to see her.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It's me. Under the veil. It's my face.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine...

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I left myself here. I left my memory on a chair in the ice and I walked out and I forgot I'd done it.

lines.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
lines.text: You came back for me. For yourself. I always hoped you would, and I always hoped you wouldn't.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Why did you leave me here?

lines.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
lines.text: Because I couldn't carry what I knew and still be kind. So I put it down. And I picked up a lab coat.

lines.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
lines.text: Sixth. You're here too. Of course you are. You were always where the hardest thing was.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What did you know? What was too heavy?

lines.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
lines.text: That the Covenant didn't break when you opened the gate. It broke before. It broke when I walked away from it. You only finished what I started.

lines.speaker: VEILED SOVEREIGN
lines.text: Lift the crown, if you want to remember. You will hate us both for a while. That's the price.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: If I lift it, I'll remember all of it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then don't. Not yet.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Vasq said every time I remember, I leave. Eleven worlds. I left eleven times.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You don't have to leave this time.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You don't know that. Neither do I. That's what terrifies me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. Something just arrived at the cavern entrance. It has no signature. And then it has one.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: I said I'd ask again when the third keeper woke. I'm a man of my word. Usually.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Hello, Seraphine. You found her. I hoped you wouldn't, for your sake.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You knew she was here.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: I carried you here. You asked me to. You were weeping. You said, "Make me someone who doesn't know." So I did.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And then you let her think she was your Second.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: She was my Second. She was the best I ever had. She simply didn't know she'd been something else first.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Sixth, my offer. Stand aside. Let Seraphine come home with me, uncrowned. The fourth seal stays asleep. Turog never gets his five. The world goes on.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Asleep. Locked. Held still.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Alive.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Together, then. If I hate you afterwards, it's your own fault.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Thank you. You're the first person in a very long time who hasn't decided for me.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I know. I know. And I'm sorry. I've spent eleven worlds not knowing.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Her neural activity is... I have never seen a human brain do this. I'm not sure it is a human brain.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Oh. Oh, no.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I remember the gate. I remember your hand on it. I remember what I said to you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What did you say?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I said, "If you open it, I will spend every world after this one making sure you never remember why." And I have. Every single one.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Welcome back, Sovereign.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'm going with him.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You don't understand yet. You will. When you remember everything, the world ends. I've watched it. Eleven times. Your hand on the gate. Every time.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then help me do it differently.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I tried. In world seven, I stayed. We tried together. I wrote it down. Read it again sometime.

lines.speaker: OREN VASQ
lines.text: Sovereign. The door.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Hold it, Oren. Like you always do.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Seraphine. Please.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Look after them, Vigilance. You were always better at it than me.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Executors in the tunnels. They are not trying to kill us. They are trying to slow us.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Then let's be fast.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Something is rising from the floor of the cavern. Ice and armour. Old.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A guardian she left with the crown. It is following her last command.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Which was?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: "Let no one follow me."

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's down. The throne is empty. The crown is gone. So is the seal.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: I'm sorry. I liked her. I don't like a lot of people.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: She took the fourth seal with her.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: She took her memory of it. The seal itself is in her. It goes where she goes.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: To the Architect.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: To the Architect. Operator... I think she was crying when she left. I don't know what my sensors are worth anymore. But I think she was.

lines.speaker: DR. HALVARD
lines.text: It's coming back. The silence. Bigger than before.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A Choir construct at the centre of it. Much larger. It is singing silence.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Singing silence. Great.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Inside its field my voice will fail. Your abilities may fail. Use the station. The generators, the flares. Anything that makes noise.

lines.speaker: DR. HALVARD
lines.text: The generators are the loudest thing we have. Keep them running and the field can't close.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: ...it's here.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: NOVA? NOVA!

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: She's gone quiet! Just shoot the big singing thing!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: ...signal... I'm back. I heard nothing for three minutes. I did not like it.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: My Cantor sang well. You only killed the song, not the singer.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Turog.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Your Sovereign has chosen the wall again. She always chooses the wall. The Architect's wall, my silence. We are the only two honest answers to a world that cannot stop ending.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: There's a third answer.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: There is always a third answer, sixth. You have tried it eleven times.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Continuum has a citadel on the Spine. It wasn't there yesterday.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Buildings don't just appear.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: This one did.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Executors. Observers. And something in the walls listening.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: You came for her. Of course.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Go home. Please.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Not without you.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'm exactly where I need to be.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: She has agreed to keep the fourth seal asleep. Here. Under my care. Turog will never have five.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And the lock never opens.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: And the world never ends.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Go. Before the Warden wakes.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: I'm sorry. It's only a machine. It will only hurt you a great deal.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's down. The Architect is gone. Seraphine is gone.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. Wait. A transmission. On my oldest channel. Only an Astryan key could use it.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Vigilance. Don't say anything. Just listen.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I lied to him. I'm good at it. I've had eleven worlds of practice.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'm restoring the fourth seal. Now. From inside his walls, where Turog can't reach it and where he won't think to look.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Fourth seal restored. The star is bright.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Tell the sixth I'm sorry. Tell them I'm not leaving this time. I'm just standing somewhere they can't see me yet.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: She did it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Four of five. And the fifth star is still moving toward the centre.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: The Ascendancy's forge is in the old Astryan foundry. Crane's been running it day and night since the broadcast.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Making what?

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: People. Better ones, he says. The Ascension Protocol was never about weapons. It was about replacing the keepers.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Replacing them with what?

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: With us. Volunteers who can hold a seal. Made, not born.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Cipher's neural resonance is rising the closer we get. Whatever they did to him, it's calling.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: If this road had a personality it would be me before coffee.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Ascendancy guards. And something with them that moves like Cipher.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Cipher. You came home. And you brought the sixth. Did you bring my equipment back too?

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: You turned the volunteers into keys.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: I turned them into hope. The keepers are ancient, half-mad and outnumbered. When Turog kills them, who holds the lock? Your Architect? The Choir?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: So you build new keepers.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: I build humanity a seat at the table. For once in its short, frightened life.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. A forge chamber just opened. Something walked out of it.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Ah. Tallis. My first. My best. He's not finished.

lines.speaker: TALLIS
lines.text: Cipher. Brother. You left me in the fire.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Tallis. I thought you were dead.

lines.speaker: TALLIS
lines.text: I was. Then I was a door. Now I'm something with a door inside it, and it won't close.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Stabilise him! Now!

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: His signature is collapsing into a keeper's pattern. He is trying to hold a seal that doesn't exist.

lines.speaker: TALLIS
lines.text: It hurts, brother. Make it stop.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Cut the core and Tallis stops burning. Maybe. I don't know.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Maybe's enough.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The core is down. Tallis's signal is not.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The forge's old guardians are waking. Astryan machines. They think we're Crane's.

lines.speaker: TALLIS
lines.text: I can't stop. I'm holding everything. Brother, I'm holding everything.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Then let go! Tallis, let go!

lines.speaker: TALLIS
lines.text: ...it's quiet. Is it quiet?

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: It's quiet.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: He's gone.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Was it worth it?

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: He held a seal-pattern for nine seconds. Nine. No human has ever done that. I've proven it can be done.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: You proved it kills them.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Today. Not forever. That's what science is, Cipher.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We're shutting this place down.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Go ahead. I've copied everything. And when your keepers die, Operator, and they will, you'll come to me. Everyone comes to me in the end.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. The fifth star has reached the centre. A Fracture is opening on the ridge. It is not a tear. It is a door.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Everybody behind the big rocks.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: No need to hide. I came to talk. And to take whatever you won't give me.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: My guard will test you first. It's a courtesy.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Good. Now me.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Show me what eleven worlds taught you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: That you talk too much.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Enough. You fight well for someone fighting the wrong war.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He isn't hurt. He's stopping because he wants to.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Do you know what seal I held, sixth? Ilyra had the song. Auren the roads. The Echo, the listening. The Sovereign, the memory.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: I held the ending. The right to close a possibility that was only going to suffer. That was my burden. And I carried it kindly.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And then I opened the gate.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: And then you said no possibility should ever be closed. Not by us. Not by anyone. You made my seal a crime.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: So I went to the ones who still believed in mercy. The Choir. They gave me a voice that could reach every world at once.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: To erase them.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: To end them gently. Before they end themselves screaming. I'll take my seal back, sixth. And then I'll close the one possibility I should have closed first. You.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A message. On my oldest channel again. "Old Harrow. The cathedral. Come alone. Bring the lamp."

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: She called me a lamp. Only the Echo calls me a lamp.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then she wants us to know it's really her.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Hello. You came alone. You never come alone.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You never ask.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'm asking now. Listen, I have very little time. The Architect isn't keeping the fourth seal asleep. He's gathering all four. He'll take them to the Origin Engine and turn the lock into a wall. Permanent. No gate. No sixth. No Choir.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No beginnings.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Nothing new, ever again. He calls it the Continuity Lock. And Turog wants the opposite: all five seals, the gate thrown open, and the Choir's silence pouring through.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Two ways to break the Covenant.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: And you're the third. You always are.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Come back with me.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Not yet. If I leave him now, he'll take the seals from the keepers by force. While he trusts me, he waits.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Executors. They followed her.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Or he sent them to see what I'd do. Make it look real.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: One more thing. You asked me in the vault what I said to you at the gate.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The rest of it. You opened the gate because Earth was going to be erased by the Choir or starved by the lock. You opened it so the people on this world could choose for themselves what was on the other side.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And the Choir came through.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Some did. And some of the people here met them, and fought them, and some of them talked to them. You gave them a door. That's all. What they did with it was always going to be theirs.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I couldn't bear it. So I ran to the Architect. And we spent eleven worlds trying to close what you opened.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And now?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Now I think you were right. I'm just very late saying so.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Choir from the north. Continuum from the south. They're not working together. They're racing.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Racing for what?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: For Ilyra, Auren and the Echo's room inside me. The three keepers in Haven. And for me.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Then they don't get any of you. Voss, the evacuation. Operator, the walls. I've got the command centre.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Director —

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: That's an order, Commander. For once in my life let me give one that isn't for sale.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Same walls. Same mud. Worse odds.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: You love it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The northern wall is breaking. Something huge is coming through.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A siege construct. Built to break walls and the people behind them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's down. The command centre has stopped answering.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: ...there you are. Late. As usual.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Ward. Hold on.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: I've been holding on. It's very overrated. Did they get out?

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Every transport's away. Every civilian.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Good. Good. Voss. You're the Director now. Don't take anyone's money.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I won't.

lines.speaker: WARD
lines.text: Liar. Take it when it saves people. Just tell them you took it. That's the only difference between us and them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Her heart has stopped. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Haven's lost. We go. Now.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Eighteen thousand people and nowhere to put them. Except one place.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: The Underground City. They don't take outsiders.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: They take me. I've been running fuel to them for six years. They owe me.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Enough to take eighteen thousand?

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: We're about to find out.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Raider camps along the highway. They are flying Choir colours.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: The Choir's been recruiting out here. Promising an end to the dust.

lines.speaker: RAIDER
lines.text: Turn back! The quiet's coming for all of you anyway!

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Not today it isn't.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: They're talking about it in there. Arguing. Hold them off till they're done arguing.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The gate is opening.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: They'll take them. All of them. Fuel debt's paid in full, they said.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Kael. Thank you.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Don't thank me. Thank the six years of fuel runs. And the operator who kept walking into things.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We need somewhere the keepers can hide.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: This is somewhere. It's the most somewhere left.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Three of us in one room. It hasn't happened since the sanctuary.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: And one of us in a lamp.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...a warm lamp...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Four seals restored. The fifth is Turog's.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: My map says he keeps it in the Shattered Expanse. Where the world is most broken. He likes it there. It agrees with him.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: And the Architect has the Sovereign, and through her, the fourth.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine's with us. She's inside his walls.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I believe you. I'm not sure she does.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Three readings. Far apart. The crater, the scrapyard, the dust rose. The map will do the rest.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: There. The Shattered Expanse. A place that's never finished falling.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. The Witness. It's here. It's... showing us something.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Observe.

lines.speaker: MEMORY
lines.text: This is world nine. The sixth has remembered everything. The sixth opens the gate fully, alone, in anger.

lines.speaker: MEMORY
lines.text: The Architect locks the world. The Choir pours through the cracks in the lock. Nothing is left that can make a sound.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why show me this?

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Because you asked. In world nine. You asked me to show you, if there was a world twelve.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Is there?

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: You are standing in it. Unwritten. Continue.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: So. The Shattered Expanse. A demigod with a seal of endings. An Architect with a wall.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: And us.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: We've had worse odds.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: We have not had worse odds.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Tallis would have liked this. All of us in one room, arguing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Get some sleep. We go at dawn.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. Before the Expanse... the Architect will go to the Origin Engine. If he locks the world before we reach Turog, it won't matter who has the fifth seal.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we go to the Engine first.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: Four seals sing. The deep door hears them. Sixth bearer. You may pass.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What's beyond it?

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: The world the first world built to keep itself. The Engine. It has been waiting for someone to come and ask it why.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I'm coming with you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Voss, you're the Director now.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: And the Director's going where the war is. Ward would have kicked me down those stairs herself.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The stair goes down further than the planet's crust. It is not going down. It is going sideways, into somewhere else.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: I'm going to pretend I didn't hear that.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Astryan sentinels. Dormant for longer than humanity has existed. Waking now.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Hostile?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Confused. Which in a sentinel is the same thing.

lines.speaker: ENGINE VOICE
lines.text: Welcome back, Vigilance. Welcome back, Promise. The Engine has been waiting.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It knows me.

lines.speaker: ENGINE VOICE
lines.text: All terminals at your disposal. Districts: Arrival, Capital, Archives, Foundries, Gardens, the Chamber, the Heart.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: It's a city. Under the city.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Not under. Beside. Folded. This is the Astryans' last world. They kept it when the first one ended.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I can read the Engine through its terminals. Let me in.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Go.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I have a map. And a history.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Riftwalkers. The Eternal Guard's scouts. They step between layers to flank you.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Then watch every side at once.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Astryans split over the Engine. Three factions. The Preservationists wanted to protect reality from being changed at all.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Ascendants wanted to evolve beyond bodies. Beyond worlds. The Continuity Council wanted to control reality so it could never collapse.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Crane. The Architect. And...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: And my maker. A Preservationist. They lost the vote.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: So everything that's happening now —

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: — is the same argument. It never ended. It only changed hands.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The transit still runs. Of course it does. The Astryans built things to outlast them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Capital. Preserved at the moment the Engine turned.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: There are tables still set. Doors still open.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: It's like the city stepped out for a minute and never came back.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It did step out. For a minute. The minute just hasn't ended.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM CHILD
lines.text: Are you the Promise? Mama said the Promise would come and the turning would be all right.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I don't know if it'll be all right.

lines.speaker: PHANTOM CHILD
lines.text: That's what grown-ups say before something bad. Is Vigilance with you? Vigilance tells the best stories.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: ...I tell stories?

lines.speaker: PHANTOM CHILD
lines.text: The best ones. About the people before the people. And the question nobody can answer.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, she is an Archive Phantom. A memory the Engine keeps walking. She has been asking that question for... a very long time.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Eternal Guard are reacting to the Continuity Council's last order. Hold the Capital against everyone.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The hall replays the vote. I can let you see it.

lines.speaker: COUNCILLOR
lines.text: The Continuity Council moves to turn the Engine. To fix the world in place. No more collapse.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: If you fix it in place, it stops being alive. You'll have a museum with people in it.

lines.speaker: COUNCILLOR
lines.text: A museum survives. The vote is carried.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: That councillor. The voice.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The Architect.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Every Astryan who ever lived is recorded here. Every timeline the Engine touched.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Find the councillor.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Found.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Councillor Idris Maelor. Head of the Continuity Council. He moved to turn the Engine.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: When it turned, the Astryans didn't die. They became... possibilities. Scattered across every layer. The Engine changed the relationship between realities, not just their shape.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Maelor bound himself to the Engine's continuity function so he would survive. He has been alive ever since. Rebuilding the world each time it ends, the way he thinks it should be.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The Architect.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He chose the name. The record notes he chose it the same day he forgot his own.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A guardian of the archive. It is made of every record anyone tried to destroy.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's quiet. The archive is letting us read.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: There is one more record about Maelor. A personal one.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: "Day one of the new world. Everyone I loved is a possibility now. I cannot find them in any layer. I will hold this world still until I do."

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: He's looking for his family.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: For a very long time.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: That doesn't make him right.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No. It makes him easier to understand. That's worse.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Gardens. My maker worked here. I... I know the path. Left at the fountain. Under the dragon arch.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Dragon arch?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The dragons' records are kept here. The Astryans' allies. Their lineages are written on the arch. One of them is the Ashen line.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The gardens' wardens are tending the plants and anything that steps on them.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Watch your feet.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: Vigilance. If you are hearing this, you came home. I'm Elenya Sarr. I made you. I'm sorry I'm not here.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: There's something you need to know. Something the Council never knew.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: We didn't invent the Promise. We found them. Asleep, in the ruins of the people before us. The Elyndra had left them there. A sixth keeper, for a lock that didn't exist yet.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: We woke them. They asked us one thing. Not to turn the Engine. We didn't listen. I've regretted it every hour since.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm older than the Astryans.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: Look after them, Vigilance. They don't remember how old they are. That's the kindest thing the world ever did for them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I was asleep in the Elyndra ruins. Before the Astryans. Before the Covenant.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Echo said the Elyndra asked a question. Maybe you are part of the answer they left behind.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: So you're ancient. Fine. You still owe me for the truck you crashed in the Eastern blocks.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: ...Thanks, Voss.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Somebody has to keep you human.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Chamber was the Continuity Council's. The Architect has been using it as his laboratory.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Architect's Inner Circle. His oldest servants. Some of them were Astryans.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Pods. Hundreds. Each one holds a memory. Each memory is yours.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Mine?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: From the other worlds. Everything you were in worlds one to eleven. He kept it. Every time a world ended, he took what you remembered and put it here, so you'd wake up empty.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: He's been harvesting you.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Studying them. Trying to find the one version that wouldn't open the gate.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Seraphine.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You're early. I was going to blow this place up before you got here. It was going to be a surprise.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: If you open the pods, the memories go back to you. All at once.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And every time I remember everything, the world ends.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: So we don't give them back. We let them go. Free. Into the Engine. They'll find you slowly. The way memories should.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Pods opening. The memories are... drifting. Like light.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: He knows. He's coming. Hold the door.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Like Vasq?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Better than Vasq. I'm on your side of it this time.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: You let them go. Eleven worlds of study, drifting off like dandelion seed.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: They weren't yours, Idris.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: ...Nobody's called me that in a very long time.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: We read the archives. You're looking for your family.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: I'm keeping the world still enough to find them. If it never changes again, I will find them eventually. I have nothing but time.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And everyone else lives in your museum.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Everyone else lives. That is more than any world before this one has managed. Stand aside, Promise.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: I am not a fighter. So I wear one.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A Sovereign Machine. The Astryans built twelve. This is the last.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Enough. You've won the fight. I've won the time.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He's at the Heart. He has the four seals' pattern. He took it from Seraphine's mind while she was beside him.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I let him. I had to make him believe me.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: The Continuity Lock has begun. Seven days and the world will hold still forever. No gate. No Choir. No endings.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Only the fifth seal can stop it now. And it is in the hands of a man who wants to end everything. Choose your monster, Promise.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He's gone. Into the Heart. It has sealed behind him.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Seven days.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we go to the Expanse. We take the fifth seal from Turog. And we come back.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Six days, four hours on the Continuity Lock. I can feel it. The world is getting... stiffer.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: This is it. The mark outside the edge of the glass. My map has been drawing it since the day it was made.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The Zero Point. Where possibilities meet. The Elyndra found it. The Astryans feared it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And Turog keeps his seal here.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: He keeps himself here. The seal is just what he keeps it in.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The reefs here are not anchored to anything. They drift between layers.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: So the ground moves.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The ground is a suggestion.

lines.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
lines.text: Turn back, little possibility. Your ending has been written kindly.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: I'll write my own, thanks.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Here. The glass stops drawing. Everything past this point is... ink nobody has spilled yet.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...lighthouse... the Zero Point remembers us... it will show you the war if you ask...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we ask.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Careful. The last time you asked an archive for a memory, you stopped breathing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Nine seconds. I'll be quicker this time.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The reconstruction will start when you step into the field. Hold on to something. Preferably me.

lines.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
lines.text: Log of the Concord's expedition. Day ninety. We have found it. A place where every possible road meets every other.

lines.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
lines.text: There is something at the centre. A seed. It is not ours. It was here before us. Before anything.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Auren. Come away from it. The Concord said observe. Only observe.

lines.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
lines.text: It's showing me maps, Ilyra. Every map. Every world that could ever be.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator, the reconstruction is splitting. There are three versions of this moment playing at once.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Three?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: In one, Auren steps back. In one, he touches the Seed. In one... he was never there at all.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: ...I remember all three. That's the trouble with this place. It doesn't decide.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Phantoms of all three versions are colliding. They are hostile to anything that is only one thing.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll be stubborn.

lines.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
lines.text: We tried to speak to whatever made the Seed. We called it the First Contact.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: And something answered.

lines.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
lines.text: Not an answer. A question. The same question, in every one of us. Who decides what may exist?

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: And we've been fighting about it ever since.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: That's the First War. Not a war of nations. A war about that question.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The Choir had a hall here. Before they were the Choir. When they were just Elyndra who were very, very tired.

lines.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
lines.text: Every possibility that fails, fails in pain. The Seed makes more of them every hour.

lines.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
lines.text: Mercy is the closing of a door before the screaming starts. We will be that mercy.

lines.speaker: TUROG (MEMORY)
lines.text: I will lead them. I've seen what the failing worlds become. Somebody has to be brave enough to end them.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Vael. You were a healer.

lines.speaker: TUROG (MEMORY)
lines.text: I still am, Ilyra. I'm just treating something bigger.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: This is Turog before the Covenant. Before he was a keeper.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: He was Choir first.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: And then he came home to the Covenant. And then he left again. He's been leaving his whole life.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: A Choir construct older than the Cantor. It keeps their doctrine, and it sings it at whoever comes in.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: I hate music.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Silent. The doctrine stops repeating.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: You broke my old hymn. I wrote that, you know. When I was young and sure.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You're not sure now?

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: I'm sure of different things. Come to the spire, sixth. Bring your keepers. Let's finish the argument we started before your world had a name.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: The Unbound left waymarks. Three of them. They didn't want to win. They wanted to leave.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: I understand them better than anyone else in this story.

lines.speaker: UNBOUND ELDER
lines.text: The Concord would harmonise every world. The Choir would end the failing ones. Both would decide for everyone.

lines.speaker: UNBOUND ELDER
lines.text: We will decide nothing for anyone. We'll close the Zero Point and walk away.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: And the Seed?

lines.speaker: UNBOUND ELDER
lines.text: We'll take a little of it with us. Not to use. To keep. One possibility nobody gets to write. A promise.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: ...The Promise.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. Your signature. It matches the fragment they carried.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I was made from the Seed.

lines.speaker: UNBOUND ELDER
lines.text: Not made. Planted. Something that will grow into whatever it chooses. When the time comes, let it choose the door.

lines.speaker: UNBOUND ELDER
lines.text: The Choir found us. Hold them so the Promise gets away.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm a seed.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You're a choice nobody else made. That's what they left in you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It explains why nobody can predict you. Not the Architect. Not the Engine. Not the map.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: You can't map a road nobody has decided to build.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll decide.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The final reconstruction. The last day of the First War.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: The Concord Engine is failing. If it fails, the Seed splits every history at once.

lines.speaker: TUROG (MEMORY)
lines.text: Then let it split! Let the Choir close the halves that fail!

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Vael, we don't destroy it. We stabilise it. Help me hold it.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Engine has three pillars. We don't break them. We balance them. All three at once.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: In a memory.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: In a memory that is still happening. The Zero Point doesn't do past tense.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Balanced. Just. The Engine holds.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: It held. But the Seed... it's splitting anyway. Our histories. We're drifting apart.

lines.speaker: AUREN (MEMORY)
lines.text: Every map is coming apart in my hands. I can't find you, Ilyra. You're on a road I can't see.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Observed.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: The Witness. It's sealing the record. So no one can use the Seed as a weapon again.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: One record will remain. For the Promise. When it is ready to ask.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Elyndra didn't lose the war. They became possibilities that could no longer reach each other.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Like the Astryans, after the Engine. Like everything that tries to answer the question.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I lost everyone that day. Everyone but four. We made a Covenant, the five of us. And then the Promise woke and made six.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And Turog?

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: We forgave him. He came home. He held the seal of endings because he understood it better than any of us.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Five days, eleven hours on the lock.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: The Witness said one record remained. For me. When I was ready to ask.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The vault doesn't appear on any of my instruments. It appears on Auren's map. And in my memory.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It's waiting for you. Only you.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Promise. You have come to ask.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm ready.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Readiness is not observed. Choice is. Observe: three worlds. In one, everyone you love is safe and nothing new is ever born. In one, everything is possible and much of it ends. In one, you choose for all of them.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Choose for these worlds.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Observed. You did not force. Continue.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Observed. You asked. Few ask. Continue.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Observed. A door is not a decision. It is a permission. Continue.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: The last record. For you.

lines.speaker: MEMORY
lines.text: This is the Promise, the first time it woke. It asked the Astryans one thing. Do not turn the Engine. It asked the Covenant one thing. Let the people choose.

lines.speaker: MEMORY
lines.text: It asked the Witness one thing. If I forget, remind me that I was asked to choose, not to win.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Reminded. Continue.

lines.speaker: NOVA
