lines.text: Operator, the spire is wrapped in a Choir silence field. Nothing gets through it. Not you. Not me.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Turog's last wall.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Not quite. There is something inside me that the field doesn't touch. The Witness called it Origin Memory Zero. I have never been able to open it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Try.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: This will take time. And I will not be able to talk. Please keep talking to me anyway.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm here. Take your time.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. Look at me.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: NOVA. You're...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: This is what I was. Before the voice package. Before the tactical overlay. The Astryans' last lighthouse.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Memory Zero isn't Astryan. It's older. It was in the Seed-fragment they found you with. Elenya put a piece of it in me. So I could always find you.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: She's beautiful.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Thank you. I am also, for the first time, slightly frightened of myself. The field is open. Go.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Last climb.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: You said that at the abbey.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: I mean it more now.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: You came. With all of them. Ilyra. Auren. The Echo in your lamp. Even the Sovereign.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Vael. Come home.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: I came home once, Ilyra. And then the Promise made my seal a crime.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I didn't make it a crime. I made it a choice. You wanted to make it for everyone.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Someone has to. The Architect will hold the world still in five days. Better an ending than a cage.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Better a door than both.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Then let's finish it, little seed.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He's not holding back this time.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: ...There. You won. Again. You always win the fight. It's the rest you never finish.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Take it. The seal. It's eating me. It always did.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why give it to me?

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Because someone must be able to end things, or nothing means anything. And you're the only one I've ever met who'd hate doing it.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Vael.

lines.speaker: VAEL TUROG
lines.text: Sing for me, Ilyra. The old one. The one about the river.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Fifth seal restored. All five stars are bright.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: He's gone.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: No. He's ended. He'd want the right word.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Four days, two hours. The city's clocks have started agreeing with each other to the millisecond. That has never happened before.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Is that bad?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It is the world holding its breath. Forever, if he finishes.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: NOVA. The sealed room. The Unwritten Future.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: I think I can open it now. All five seals are bright. I think that's what it was waiting for.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Hold my hand. Metaphorically. Or literally, if you have a moment.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm here.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's open.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: Vigilance. If you've opened this, the seals are bright and the Promise is awake and somebody is trying to hold the world still.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: I hid a plan from the Council. A new Covenant. Not five keepers holding a lock. A door with keepers on both sides of it. Elyndra, Astryan, human. And the Promise on the threshold.

lines.speaker: ASTRYAN MAKER
lines.text: Not a wall. Not an ending. A door that is kept. That's all I ever wanted. A door that is kept.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Can it be done?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It needs the five seals, the Promise, the Heart of the Engine, and people. Many people. From this world, choosing it.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: A kept door. She was always the wisest of them.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: My map just drew a road it's never drawn before. Through the Heart and out the other side.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...the lamp is very bright today...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we need everyone. Every faction. Every city.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Everyone hates each other.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Everyone hates being held still more.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Seraphine's signal. She's out of the Heart. She's on the roof where we found the data core.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Of course she is.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: He let me go. He said he didn't need me anymore. He said it kindly. That's how I knew he meant it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You're out.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'm out. And I have to decide what I am now. His Sovereign. A keeper. Or a tired woman in a lab coat.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You don't have to decide alone.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Yes, I do. That's the whole point. You taught me that. Eleven worlds of other people deciding for me. This one's mine.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I am Seraphine Vale. Once the Veiled Sovereign, keeper of the fourth seal. Once the Second of the Continuum. Once a researcher with a very bad coffee habit.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I choose the Covenant. Not the old one. The kept door.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Fourth seal... it's singing. With her.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: And I choose to stay. In this world. Whatever happens. No more leaving.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No more leaving.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Don't look so pleased. You're still going to have to listen to me be right about everything.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: You came to me. I told you everyone does.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm not asking you to make keepers. I'm asking you to stand at a door.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: ...A seat at the table. For humanity. Not built in a forge. Given.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Earned. By standing there when it's hard.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: Tallis would have laughed at me. All that fire, and the answer was to ask.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: The Ascendancy will stand. Every shield I have. For once in my life I'd like to be on the side that wins without cheating.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Frontier Defense. Every soldier we have left.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Free Operators. Every one who still answers my calls, and a few who don't.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: The Ascendancy. Shields up.

lines.speaker: CHIEF ODA
lines.text: Depth Engineers. We came up for this. Don't make me regret the sunlight.

lines.speaker: ELDER MAREN
lines.text: The rangers of Eldergrove. The forest sends its regards.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: Goliath.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: Nyx.

lines.speaker: CIPHER
lines.text: Cipher. For Tallis.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Three days ago this city couldn't agree on who owned a data core.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Three days ago nobody was trying to hold the sky still.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Continuum knows. Executors and Eternal Guard at every street into the Old Quarter.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Then we take every street.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: Five seals sing. The Promise returns. With... many.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: They're with me.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE WARDEN
lines.text: Then the archive is with you also. It has waited a long time for a crowd.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Two days. The Heart is sealed. The Engine will only open it to an answer.

lines.speaker: SEVENTH PROTOCOL
lines.text: Seventh Protocol. The shared intelligence of the Engine's guardians, reconnected.

lines.speaker: SEVENTH PROTOCOL
lines.text: Promise. Before the Heart opens, answer. Which reality are you attempting to save?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Take your time. It has waited longer than anyone.

lines.speaker: SEVENTH PROTOCOL
lines.text: A small answer. Honest. The Heart accepts honesty.

lines.speaker: SEVENTH PROTOCOL
lines.text: A large answer. Impossible. The Heart accepts the attempt.

lines.speaker: SEVENTH PROTOCOL
lines.text: An unwritten answer. The Heart was built for nothing else.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Heart is open.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Of course it is. It always liked you better.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Idris.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Seraphine. You chose. Good. I hoped you would. I'm sorry it wasn't me.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Come in, Promise. One day left. Let's see if you can stop a man with nothing but time.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Eleven worlds I've held together with my own hands. I won't let go of the twelfth because a seed asked nicely.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll stop asking.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: ...Enough. Enough. I'm so tired. I've been tired since before your world had oceans.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Do you know what I see, when the Engine turns? Them. My wife. My son. Possibilities in the next layer, just out of reach. Every time.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Idris. You'll never find them by holding everything still.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: No. I know. I've known for a very long time. Stillness was just easier to bear than looking.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Well, Promise. You have me. Decide.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Fair. Quick, please. I've had enough slow.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He's gone. The lock is failing.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: You'd carry it? You'd be the Architect?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No. I'd be the one who keeps the door.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: ...Then you'll do it better than I did. It's not a high bar.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: Let me go? After everything?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Go and look. Properly this time.

lines.speaker: THE ARCHITECT
lines.text: ...Thank you. If I find them, I'll tell them about you. They'll think I'm making it up.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Continuity Lock is breaking. And the old lock with it. The one Earth has held since the Covenant.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Without a wall, there's nothing between this world and the Choir.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Choir signatures. Thousands. Coming through every crack at once.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then we hold the door until it's kept.

lines.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
lines.text: Possibility. Your cage is broken. Let us end you gently, before you end yourselves screaming.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: All units! They're coming through the sky!

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Keepers! To me! The way we stood at the sanctuary!

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Every map I ever drew ends here. Let's draw past it.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I'm singing. Don't let anything near me.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Nothing gets near you.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Something huge is descending into the plaza. It is a chorus of Choir constructs bound into one.

lines.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
lines.text: WE ARE MANY. WE ARE MERCY.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: You're loud, is what you are.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: It's coming apart. The Choir is... hesitating.

lines.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
lines.text: ...the possibility... resists... it is not screaming...

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: It's singing. Listen. The whole city.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Eighteen thousand people from Haven. The Underground. Thalassia's engineers. The rangers. All broadcasting. All at once.

lines.speaker: CHOIR VOICE
lines.text: ...why do you sing, failing world...

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Because we're not failing. We're choosing.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. The memories from the pods. They've found you. All of them. They're coming back at once.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Every time I remember everything, the world ends.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Every time you remembered alone.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Hold my hand. NOVA, hold the other one. Ilyra, Auren, Echo. All of you. Let them come back to all of us.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The memories are taking shape. Every ending, all around you. Don't let go.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I remember. All of it. The seed. The ruins. The Astryans waking me. The gate. Every world.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The world is still here.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Of course it is. You didn't carry it alone this time.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: In every world I was afraid I'd chosen wrong. And so I did it again harder.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: And this time?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: This time I'm not afraid of choosing. I'm afraid of choosing for them. So I won't.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: This is where it was always going. The gate. The same gate. Your hand.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: You could restore the old Covenant. Five keepers. A lock. This world safe, and small, and asleep.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: You could open the gate all the way. Every road open. No keepers. Whatever comes, comes.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Or Elenya's door. Kept on both sides. By us and by them. Harder than either. Never finished.

lines.speaker: THE ECHO
lines.text: ...the Promise was planted to choose... so choose...

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Whatever you choose, I'll keep the record. All of it. That's what I'm for.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: Then we hold it. Gladly. For as long as you need us to.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Lock restored. The world is quiet. It is very safe.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: Then let's see where the roads go. All of them.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Gate open. The sky is full of other skies.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Kept. Of course you did.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The door is kept. On both sides. I can hear people on the other side. Some of them are singing back.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The Choir constructs that won't stop. The ones built only to end things.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then let's give them an ending. A kind one.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The last of them. You still carry Turog's seal.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Someone has to be able to end things. Or nothing means anything.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: He said you'd hate doing it.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: He was right.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: The clocks have stopped agreeing with each other. They're a little bit wrong again. Every one of them.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: It's moving. The world. You can feel it.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: So what now?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Now we find out.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Three months. Haven is rebuilt. Voss insisted on bigger walls and Kael insisted on bigger gates.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who won?

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Both. They argued so long the builders made the gates big enough to drive a wall through.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Hey! It's you! You're the one from the bus!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Daniel. You got big.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: It's been, like, a year. Dad's OK. His leg's weird but he's OK.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: Everyone says you saved the world.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Everyone saved the world. I just held the door.

lines.speaker: DANIEL
lines.text: That's what a door does, though. Right? It's the most important bit.

lines.speaker: VOSS
lines.text: Director Voss. I hate it. Ward would laugh.

lines.speaker: KAEL
lines.text: Ward would make you file a report about hating it.

lines.speaker: CRANE
lines.text: The Ascendancy's new program is very simple. We ask people what they want before we change them. Revolutionary.

lines.speaker: ILYRA SEN
lines.text: I'm going back to the falls. The water's been nervous without me.

lines.speaker: AUREN THALE
lines.text: And I'm going to walk off the edge of the map. There's an edge again. Isn't that wonderful?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: I'm staying. Somebody has to be right about everything around here.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: And I am keeping the record. All of it. Including the part where Goliath cried at the sunrise.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: I had sand in my eye.

lines.speaker: NYX
lines.text: There was no sand.

lines.speaker: GOLIATH
lines.text: There was emotional sand.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: Operator. It's here.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: Observed.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Hello again.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: You chose without forcing. The question is satisfied. For now.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: For now?

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: There is an older question. Asked before the Seed. Before the Elyndra. Before anything.

lines.speaker: FIRST WITNESS
lines.text: If existence could begin again, would you choose the same world?

lines.speaker: SERAPHINE
lines.text: Don't answer it tonight.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I wasn't going to.

lines.speaker: NOVA
lines.text: End of record. Beginning of the next one.
